title: Borderless Maximize Window - Stuck Maximized
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5.1 (mono tested)

### System information

 OS Garuda Linux x86_64 ├ Kernel Linux 6.18.4-zen1-1-zen ├󰏖 Packages 1976 (pacman)[stable], 20 (flatpak-system), 27 (flatpak-user) └ Shell fish 4.3.3   DE KDE Plasma 6.5.4 ├󰧨 Window Manager KWin (Wayland) ├󰧨 Login Manager sddm 0.21.0 (Wayland) ├󰉼 WM Theme Sweet-Dark ├󰉼 Color Themes Dr460nized (Sweet) [Qt], Sweet-Dark [GTK2/3/4] ├󰀻 System Icons BeautyLine [Qt], BeautyLine [GTK2/3/4] ├ System Fonts Fira Sans (10pt) [Qt], Fira Sans (10pt) [GTK2/3/4] └ Terminal konsole 25.12.1  󰌢 PC Desktop ├󰻠 CPU AMD Ryzen 5 5600X (12) @ 4.65 GHz ├󰍛 GPU NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Lite Hash Rate [Discrete] ├󰍛 OpenGL 4.6.0 NVIDIA 580.119.02 ├󰍛 Vulkan 1.4.312 - NVIDIA [580.119.02] └󰍹 Display(s) 1920x1080 in 24", 60 Hz [External] └󰍹 Display(s) 2560x1080 in 34", 60 Hz [External] * └󰍹 Display(s) 1920x1080 in 16", 60 Hz [External] └󰍹 Display(s) 1920x1080 in 42", 60 Hz [External]

### Issue description

@deralmas 

This issue is one unresolved piece of this issue (for history):  https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/92823#issuecomment-3733682041

KDE Plasma [Wayland] (at least): 
~/.config/kwinrc contains settings for the desktop.  If we do this:

`[Windows]
BorderlessMaximizedWindows=false`

...essentially if we don't want to use the permanent top bar, native KDE applications (like Dolphin), when maximized, allow clicking (+ holding) and dragging down to pull the window out of a maximized state.

This does not happen in Godot, so the only way to get out of the maximized state is to use the "windows key" + arrow keys (which isn't muscle memory for everyone).

### Steps to reproduce

1.  Open any project in the editor.
2.  Maximize the window.
3.  Attempt to un-maximize it without the keyboard
4.  Despair xD
